description: This is a C source file for a sample application 'sample_super' that demonstrates message sending, requesting, listening, and discovery functionalities using RT messaging libraries. It includes functions for handling messages, discovering topics and components, and a main function that manages command-line options to perform various RT messaging operations.

methods.name: printHelp
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the sample application.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Callback function invoked upon receiving a message; processes the message and sends a response if it's a request.

methods.name: discoverWildcardDestinations
methods.description: Performs discovery of wildcard destinations matching a given expression.

methods.name: discoverObjectElements
methods.description: Discovers object elements for a specified object.

methods.name: discoverElementObjects
methods.description: Discovers element objects for specified elements.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments, sets up connection, and performs messaging or discovery operations accordingly.
